content:
**Cranberry Cobbler** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

This dish is a thick-crusted, pie-like cobbler made with Cranberries. It gives a moderate boost to earned XP while moderately healing HP, satisfying hunger, and giving a medium dose of Radiation.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Cranberries (1) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned on pickup Cranberries | | Cranberry Cobbler (1) | 

Can be crafted at a Cooking Station with the correct ingredients after having picked up Cranberries for the first time.

The XP bonus does not stack with any other XP boosting food or drink. It will, however, stack with XP boosts from Lunchboxes and bonus XP community events.
